The staff is very patient as you glacialy browse through their range. It can seem like forever to find something cause their selection is vast, but the staff knows their way around the place and will be the best guide to help you decide.

Many fabric shops don't let you take a swatch or even a picture of it.. That kind of sucks cause you need to compare and realise it to your actual home. They were courteous enough to lend me their book. I guess this also depends on how comfortable you are with them, so it worked for me but it may not work for you. Once you choose, their stitching is immaculate and delivery is very prompt..i needed it in 4 days and they delivered. I highly recommend them.
